name: Md. Raisul Islam Ratul
titles: Hi, I'm Md. Raisul Islam Ratul
summary: Final-year EECE undergraduate and IEEE-published researcher specializing in VLSI & IC physical design, embedded systems, and engineering automation. Proven experience in custom layouts and GDSII verification from industry attachments at Neural Semiconductor and Ulkasemi, alongside leadership as President of the MIST Robotics Club.

education.institution: Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST)
education.description: Coursework: VLSI Design • Power Systems • Control Systems • Digital Electronics • Microprocessors & Embedded Systems • Communication Systems • Signal Processing • Electrical Machines

training.title: IC Design, Custom Layout & Verification
training.description: Analog/digital IC design, standard-cell layout, custom design methodologies, and DRC/LVS physical verification.

training.title: Front-End IC Design & GDSII Verification
training.description: Observed front-end IC design workflows, timing closure, front-end architecture, and GDSII physical verification in an operational semiconductor design house.

training.title: Electronics Manufacturing & QC
training.description: Observed PCB assembly line, SMT automated manufacturing, product testing, and quality control workflows.

projects.title: Low-Power LECTOR CS-VCO (90nm CMOS)
projects.description: Custom layout Current-Starved VCO in 90nm CMOS using LECTOR (Leakage Control Transistors) technique. Achieved ~90% static power reduction (consuming only 95.472 µW at 3.873–5.526 GHz). DRC & LVS clean, published at IEEE ICCIT 2025.

projects.title: 3:1 Configurable Logic Block (CLB) VLSI
projects.description: Custom transistor-level design, layout, floorplanning, physical verification (DRC & LVS clean), and performance characterization of a 3:1 CLB FPGA unit using Cadence Virtuoso. Features custom 6T SRAM cells and 8x1 MUX LUT.

projects.title: 4:1 MUX — 9 Logic Style Comparison
projects.description: Benchmarked 9 distinct logic styles (including CMOS, PTL, and GDI) at the 90nm node. Evaluated metrics of power dissipation, delay, and layout area, identifying GDI as optimal for low-power ALU designs.

projects.title: ANTORIP — Event Ticketing Platform
projects.description: Large-scale ticketing application handling 4,500+ registrations. Implemented real-time booking, QR-based ticket verification, automated email pipelines, and real-time transaction reporting.

projects.title: POS / ERP SME Enterprise System
projects.description: Comprehensive ERP system built for small-to-medium businesses. Features robust inventory tracking, role-based access control, transaction ledger, and automated analytical reporting.

projects.title: PCM Modulation & Decoding System
projects.description: Academic communication design project. Built a hardware-based Pulse Code Modulation (PCM) encoder and decoder system with dual-layer PCB layouts in Proteus, and Simulink simulations.

projects.title: Audio Signal Denoising via Autocorrelation
projects.description: Implemented autocorrelation-based noise reduction pipeline in MATLAB — demonstrates applied DSP theory for real-world audio signal restoration.

projects.title: Distinctive Word Audio Analysis
projects.description: Time-domain and frequency-domain characterization of phoneme-level audio signals — foundational work bridging DSP and speech recognition pipelines.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Personal portfolio deployed on Vercel — showcasing VLSI research, FPGA projects, and full-stack work in a responsive, performance-optimized interface.
